title: 12 Best Cocktail Bars in Roppongi — The Unfiltered Guide
description: The best cocktail bars in Roppongi, Tokyo — curated from Reddit reviews. Bar Starman, THESE, Musium, Roku Nana, AGAVE & more. Speakeasies, rooftop bars, and honest verdicts.

places.name: Bar Starman

redditQuotes.text: Bar Starman is one of my favorite bars in Tokyo. Tiny place on the 3rd floor, incredible cocktails. The bartender is a master — tell him what you like and he'll make something perfect.
redditQuotes.source: — Yelp reviewer · TOP 10 Cocktail Bars near Roppongi, 2025

places.verdict: Roppongi's highest-rated cocktail bar — a tiny 3rd-floor gem where the bartender crafts drinks to match your mood. The kind of bar you discover once and return to every trip.

comparison.best for: Intimate cocktail experience, solo drinking, couples
comparison.strengths: 4.8★ from 203 Google reviews · Personalized cocktails · Quiet atmosphere
comparison.limitations: Very small — seats maybe 8–10 people. No reservations, just show up.
comparison.what to order: Don't order from a menu. Tell the bartender what flavors or spirits you like and let him create something. That's the entire point of Bar Starman — bespoke cocktails made to your taste. The bartender's whiskey-based creations are particularly celebrated.

places.whatToOrder: Don't order from a menu. Tell the bartender what flavors or spirits you like and let him create something. That's the entire point of Bar Starman — bespoke cocktails made to your taste. The bartender's whiskey-based creations are particularly celebrated.

places.name: THESE

redditQuotes.text: THESE is a bar located in Roppongi and is a real gem. The vibe is fantastic and is one of those few places where you can chill without the worry of time or noise. It's lively enough not to be awkward, but quiet enough not to have to yell at your friends.
redditQuotes.source: — styleofatokyoite.com · Tokyo's Best Nightlife Spots guide

places.verdict: A Nishiazabu library lounge where the vibe is "chill enough to talk, lively enough not to be awkward." One of the few Roppongi-area bars that genuinely feels like a neighborhood spot.

comparison.strengths: 4.3★ from 498 Google reviews · Warm atmosphere · Counter + upstairs seating
comparison.limitations: Not in central Roppongi — it's in Nishiazabu (10-min walk from Roppongi Station). Can get busy on weekends.
comparison.what to order: THESE has a solid cocktail menu with both classics and house originals. The whiskey highball is a reliable order, and their seasonal fruit cocktails are worth trying. The bar also does good wine and champagne if you want to switch it up.

places.whatToOrder: THESE has a solid cocktail menu with both classics and house originals. The whiskey highball is a reliable order, and their seasonal fruit cocktails are worth trying. The bar also does good wine and champagne if you want to switch it up.

knownFor: THESE has a solid cocktail menu

places.name: MUSIUM

redditQuotes.text: Musium in Roppongi was my favorite.
redditQuotes.source: — r/cocktails · Cocktail bars of Osaka and Tokyo thread

places.verdict: A record bar where the cocktails are as curated as the vinyl. Reddit's go-to recommendation for cocktails + music in Roppongi.

comparison.best for: Music lovers, solo drinking, couples who appreciate vinyl culture
comparison.strengths: 4.7★ from 102 Google reviews · Vinyl collection · Craft cocktails · Unique atmosphere
comparison.limitations: Small space. Closed Sundays. Opens late (8 PM).
comparison.what to order: Musium pairs cocktails with records — ask the bartender what's spinning and what drink goes with it. Their whiskey cocktails are strong, and they do interesting infusions. The experience is as much about the music as the drinks.

places.whatToOrder: Musium pairs cocktails with records — ask the bartender what's spinning and what drink goes with it. Their whiskey cocktails are strong, and they do interesting infusions. The experience is as much about the music as the drinks.

places.name: The Bar at The Ritz-Carlton, Tokyo

redditQuotes.text: The Roppongi Bar at the Ritz-Carlton Tokyo has a nice bar and offers a great view from the 45th floor.

places.verdict: East-meets-West cocktails 45 floors above Tokyo. The Ritz-Carlton bar is where you go when you want Roppongi's best view with cocktails to match.

comparison.best for: Special occasions, dates, sunset drinks, impressing visitors
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ · Panoramic Tokyo views · Expert bartenders · East-meets-West cocktail program
comparison.limitations: Most expensive on this list. Smart dress code enforced. Can feel formal.
comparison.what to order: The bar specializes in East-meets-West cocktails — classic Western cocktails fused with Japanese elements like yuzu, matcha, sakura, and Japanese whisky. The sake-tasting menu is also excellent. Ask the bartender for the seasonal recommendation — they take pride in showcasing Japanese ingredients.

places.name: BAUHAUS

redditQuotes.text: Bauhaus Roppongi is consistently recommended for its atmosphere. Great music, good drinks, cool basement vibe.
redditQuotes.source: — TripAdvisor · THE 15 BEST Roppongi Clubs & Bars list

places.verdict: Roppongi's most beloved rock bar — 709 Google reviews at 4.7★ speaks for itself. Great drinks, great music, zero pretension.

comparison.best for: Rock/music fans, casual drinking, groups, anyone who wants energy without clubs
comparison.strengths: 4.7★ from 709 Google reviews · Rock/punk/alternative music · Basement atmosphere · Very reasonable prices
comparison.limitations: Closed Mondays and Sundays. It's a rock bar — if you want quiet, go elsewhere.
comparison.what to order: Beer and whiskey cocktails are the move here. The drinks are solid and reasonably priced by Roppongi standards. This isn't about molecular mixology — it's about great drinks in a great atmosphere with great music. Order what you like and enjoy the vinyl.

places.whatToOrder: Beer and whiskey cocktails are the move here. The drinks are solid and reasonably priced by Roppongi standards. This isn't about molecular mixology — it's about great drinks in a great atmosphere with great music. Order what you like and enjoy the vinyl.

knownFor: whiskey cocktails are the move here

places.name: Roku Nana

redditQuotes.text: Roku Nana — rooftop speakeasy in Minato City, Roppongi, 7-chōme. One of the best hidden bars in the area.
redditQuotes.source: — Tokyo speakeasy guide · Hidden & Hushed: Best Speakeasy Bars in Tokyo

places.verdict: A hidden rooftop speakeasy that feels miles away from the Roppongi chaos below. Named "67" in Japanese — the address is the clue.

comparison.best for: Dates, rooftop vibes, groups who want something hidden and special
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ from 183 Google reviews · Rooftop terrace · Speakeasy entrance · Craft cocktails
comparison.limitations: Closed Sundays. Can be hard to find the entrance. Terrace is weather-dependent.
comparison.what to order: Roku Nana does creative seasonal cocktails with Japanese ingredients. The terrace is the real draw — order something refreshing (gin-based, citrus, or a spritz) and enjoy the rooftop air. In winter, go for whiskey cocktails or hot toddies.

places.whatToOrder: Roku Nana does creative seasonal cocktails with Japanese ingredients. The terrace is the real draw — order something refreshing (gin-based, citrus, or a spritz) and enjoy the rooftop air. In winter, go for whiskey cocktails or hot toddies.

places.name: AGAVE

redditQuotes.text: If you're a Tequila type of person, this is your place — they got more than 400 kinds of tequilas. Don't forget to enjoy their Mexican food to go with your shots.
redditQuotes.source: — Tokyo Zebra · TOP 5 Bars in Roppongi guide

places.verdict: 400+ kinds of tequila in a Roppongi basement. If you're into agave spirits, there is nowhere better in Asia — arguably nowhere better outside of Mexico.

comparison.best for: Tequila/mezcal enthusiasts, Mexican food cravings, unique experiences
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ from 269 Google reviews · 400+ tequilas · Mexican food · Basement atmosphere
comparison.limitations: Closed Sundays. Higher price point for premium tequilas. Basement can feel tight when busy.
comparison.what to order: Start with a tequila flight — the staff will guide you through different regions and aging levels. Their margaritas are excellent if you want cocktails. Don't skip the Mexican food — the tacos and nachos are legit and pair perfectly with tequila. Ask for a recommendation from their mezcal collection if you want to explore beyond tequila.

places.name: Boctok

redditQuotes.text: For a more intimate bar, I can recommend this place located in the back of the Roppongi area. The bar has a relaxed atmosphere and is the perfect place to unwind after a long day. The bar is very hidden so you won't see random drunks inside, but make sure to give them a call before you go because they are quite popular!
redditQuotes.source: — styleofatokyoite.com · Tokyo's Best Nightlife Spots guide

places.verdict: A true hidden gem in Nishiazabu's back streets — the entrance is on the one-way side, the bar is underground, and random drunks will never find it. Call ahead.

comparison.best for: Speakeasy hunters, couples, unwinding after work
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ from 150 Google reviews · Truly hidden entrance · Relaxed atmosphere · Quality cocktails
comparison.limitations: Very hard to find the entrance (one-way street side). Call before going — they're popular and small.
comparison.what to order: Boctok has an extensive cocktail and wine menu. The bartenders are skilled with classic cocktails — try a well-made old fashioned or negroni. The bar also has good beer and wine options. The relaxed atmosphere makes it a place to settle in for multiple rounds rather than a quick stop.

places.whatToOrder: Boctok has an extensive cocktail and wine menu. The bartenders are skilled with classic cocktails — try a well-made old fashioned or negroni. The bar also has good beer and wine options. The relaxed atmosphere makes it a place to settle in for multiple rounds rather than a quick stop.

places.name: Bar Propaganda

redditQuotes.text: Bar Propaganda in Roppongi is somewhere I have also had luck mingling.
redditQuotes.source: — r/cocktails · Any recommendations for bars in Tokyo thread

places.verdict: Reddit's go-to for late-night drinks in Roppongi. Open until 5–7 AM, reasonably priced, and a genuinely social bar where you can actually talk to people.

comparison.best for: Late-night drinking, socializing, meeting people, budget-friendly cocktails
comparison.strengths: 4.2★ from 359 Google reviews · Open until 5–7 AM · Affordable · Social atmosphere
comparison.limitations: Not a "craft cocktail" bar — it's more about the vibe than the mixology. Can get rowdy late.
comparison.what to order: Keep it simple — beer, highballs, basic cocktails. Bar Propaganda isn't trying to be a mixology temple. It's a social bar that happens to make decent drinks at good prices, and stays open when everything else closes. That's its superpower.

places.whatToOrder: Keep it simple — beer, highballs, basic cocktails. Bar Propaganda isn't trying to be a mixology temple. It's a social bar that happens to make decent drinks at good prices, and stays open when everything else closes. That's its superpower.

places.name: K-Julep

redditQuotes.text: Roppongi's K-Julep is another popular venue in the city center of Tokyo, offering a lively atmosphere and a great selection of drinks. The bar has a bit of a retro feel, with bright red decor lights being the main theme. K-Julep is particularly known for its fruit cocktails, offering various season specials.
redditQuotes.source: — styleofatokyoite.com · Tokyo's Best Nightlife Spots guide

places.verdict: Known for seasonal fruit cocktails with a retro red-lit atmosphere. A Roppongi favorite for solo visitors and small groups.

comparison.best for: Fruit cocktail lovers, solo drinking, small groups, retro atmosphere
comparison.strengths: 4.1★ from 82 Google reviews · Seasonal fruit cocktails · Retro ambiance · Approachable
comparison.limitations: Closed Sundays. 2nd floor location can be easy to miss.
comparison.what to order: The seasonal fruit cocktails are the whole draw. Whatever fruit is in season — strawberry in spring, peach in summer, grape in autumn — that's your order. The red-lit retro atmosphere and attentive bartenders make this a bar you'll genuinely want to return to.

places.name: R2 Supper Club

redditQuotes.text: R2 is not a cheap place, but thanks to that you don't see any junkies there. Compared to Awabar and Rigoletto, R2 is a bit more classy. Weekdays and early hours of weekends are quite relaxing, so I recommend this place for couples too. Most of the staff speak English.
redditQuotes.source: — Tokyo Zebra · TOP 5 Bars in Roppongi guide

places.verdict: Roppongi's classiest lounge — a step up from the area's rowdier spots, with competent cocktails and an international crowd. The "no junkies" filter is the cover charge.

comparison.best for: Couples, upscale nights out, international crowd
comparison.strengths: 4.0★ from 610 Google reviews · Classy atmosphere · English-speaking staff · Good food
comparison.limitations: Higher prices. The "supper club" vibe can feel corporate on slow nights. Weekend crowds skew clubby.
comparison.what to order: R2 does solid classic cocktails and champagne. The weekday early hours are the sweet spot — relaxed, classy, before the late-night energy kicks in. Their food menu is also surprisingly good if you want to combine dinner and drinks.

places.whatToOrder: R2 does solid classic cocktails and champagne. The weekday early hours are the sweet spot — relaxed, classy, before the late-night energy kicks in. Their food menu is also surprisingly good if you want to combine dinner and drinks.

places.name: Bar Rum Room Tokyo

redditQuotes.text: While not technically Tiki, Bar Rum Room in Roppongi Hills was easily my favorite bar in Tokyo.
redditQuotes.source: — r/cocktails · Have you been to any great tiki bars in Tokyo? thread

places.verdict: Reddit's "easily my favorite bar in Tokyo" — a rum-focused gem near Roppongi Hills with 4.8★ and a passionate following.

comparison.best for: Rum enthusiasts, tiki-adjacent cocktails, unique spirits experiences
comparison.strengths: 4.8★ from 61 Google reviews · Rum-focused menu · Passionate bartenders · Azabu Juban charm
comparison.limitations: Located in Azabu Juban (15-min walk from Roppongi Station). Small venue. Best to go with some rum knowledge or willingness to learn.
comparison.what to order: Let the bartender guide you through their rum collection. If you're new to rum, ask for a daiquiri made with premium aged rum — it'll change how you think about the spirit. Rum flights are also available for exploring different styles. Their tiki-inspired cocktails are excellent.
